title: Beyond Accuracy: Robustness, Cost, and Governance Trade-offs for Vision-Language Models in Templated Document Extraction
abstract: arXiv:2609.15706v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used to extract structured fields from business documents, yet most evaluations report accuracy on clean benchmarks and offer little guidance to practitioners choosing an approach for a given task complexity. We address this gap with a measurement-grounded study and an open-source release. Across eleven systems (three commercial, two reasoning, five open-source VLMs in pretrained and fine-tuned form, and a non-LLM OCR->regex floor) scored on a 750-document held-out pool of synthetic checks, fine-tuning on 3K samples lifts the best open-source VLMs above F1 0.98-above every zero-shot commercial system on this task-while GPT-5 leads the commercial pool on F1 and Claude Sonnet 4.5 collapses on Date. To turn these measurements into actionable choices, we introduce a practitioner-oriented selection framework that maps a task profile (quality, latency, governance, volume) to a recommended approach

translated_title: 超越准确率：视觉语言模型在模板化文档提取中的鲁棒性、成本与治理权衡
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）正越来越多地被用于从业务文档中提取结构化字段，然而大多数评估仅报告在干净基准上的准确率，对从业者在给定任务复杂度下如何选择方法几乎没有提供指导。我们通过一项基于实测数据的研究及开源发布来填补这一空白。在750份留出的合成支票文档池上，我们对十一个系统进行了评分（三个商业系统、两个推理模型、五个处于预训练与微调形式的开源VLM，以及一个非大语言模型的OCR→正则表达式基线），结果显示：在3K样本上进行微调可使最佳开源VLM的F1值超过0.98——高于该任务上所有零样本商业系统——同时GPT-5在商业系统中F1领先，而Claude Sonnet 4.5在日期（Date）字段上表现崩溃。为了将这些测量结果转化为可操作的选择，我们提出了一个面向从业者的选型框架，将任务画像（质量、延迟、治理、处理量）映射到推荐的方法。
tldr: 该研究通过对十一个系统在750份合成支票文档上的实测发现，仅用3K样本微调即可使最佳开源视觉语言模型的F1超过0.98并超越所有零样本商业系统，并提出一个面向从业者的选型框架，将质量、延迟、治理和处理量等任务画像映射为推荐方案。
